what: While the section is pinned, cards rise one by one from below the screen (55vh) to the center, rotating along a big circle around an axis far below the screen (125vw), and end as a fan-shaped stack spread 4° apart (75vh of scroll per card, power1.out). The big text behind fades out during the first 25%.

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Expanding card (child) — size and color set by the consuming CSS. Stands overlapping the center of the board.
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: (If present) large text behind the card — fades out during the initial fade share
options.spread: Angle between cards (deg), default 4 — split on both sides with the center as 0 (for four: -6, -2, 2, 6)
options.radius: Distance to the axis (screen width multiple), default 1.25 — radius of the original 250vw circle
options.from: Position where the card starts (screen height multiple, downward from the panel center), default .55
options.per: Scroll per card (screen height multiple), default .75
options.fade: Share of the total fixed length over which large text fades out, default .25
options.min: Fixed and expanded only at or above this width, default 768 — below it css stacks the cards vertically

note: The original puts a 250vw circle element on each card and rotates the circle and card together — the part has no wrapper and computes the same trajectory (position circling the circle + double rotation) as a single card transform

from.where: index.html·about.html .ab-tilt (reasons to trust us · qualification cards)
